It has an eight-speed automatic transmission which sends power to all four wheels.  The F-type R coupe goes from zero to 60 mph in 3.4 seconds.  It has a 10-speaker Meridian sound system, along with USB connectivity.  A standard Wi-Fi hotspot allows you and your passengers to easily connect to the internet. This 2019 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Sahara 4x4 is ready for adventure both on and off the pavement, finished in a classic Bright White Clear-Coat exterior over a Black cloth interior. * Exterior Color: Bright White Clear-Coat
* Interior Color: Black

* 3rd Generation Dana 44 HD rear axle for added durability
* Heavy-duty suspension with gas shocks
* Fuel tank, transfer case, and transmission skid plate shields
* Electronic Stability Control with Electronic Roll Mitigation and Trailer Sway Damping
* Front and rear tow hooks for off-road recovery

**Comfort & Convenience Features**

* Black Sunrider soft top for open-air driving
* Leather-wrapped steering wheel with mounted audio controls
* Power-heated mirrors
* Side steps for easy cabin access
* Tilt and telescope steering column
* Air conditioning with automatic temperature control

**Technology & Connectivity**

* Uconnect 4 with 7-inch touchscreen display
* Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
* 8-speaker audio system
* Integrated voice command with Bluetooth
* 7.0-inch TFT color instrument cluster display

**Safety Features**

* ParkView rear backup camera
* Advanced multistage front airbags
* Supplemental front seat side airbags
* Anti-lock 4-wheel disc heavy-duty brakes
* Security alarm system

This Wrangler Sahara is equipped to go wherever the road, or the trail, takes you. Visit our showroom today.

Its refined design, paired with thoughtful technology like Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, appeals to professionals and families seeking a balance of comfort, connectivity, and classic refinement. A wealth of features elevates every journey in the Tucson SEL. Smart connectivity is enabled by Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, bringing seamless access to your smartphone's functions. Cargo solutions like the cargo cover and package underscore versatility without sacrificing style, and details like the illuminated entry, remote keyless entry, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls enhance daily convenience and tactile pleasure.

While competitors offer comparable space and technology, this SUV's cabin quietness and seat comfort deliver a more relaxed, upscale environment.

What premium materials are used in the interior? The Tucson SEL features stain- and odor-resistant cloth seat trim, providing a refined yet practical touch. How quiet is the cabin? The sophisticated suspension and precision sealing create a notably tranquil atmosphere, minimizing outside noise.

description:
This 2021 Volkswagen Tiguan 2.0T SE in Blue delivers a balanced combination of capability and comfort for drivers seeking a dependable midsize SUV.

- Extended Range Remote Engine Start with extended range remote key fob
- Panoramic Sunroof Package with power tilting and sliding front section
- Frameless Auto-Dimming Rearview Mirror with electronic compass and HomeLink
- Heated Front Comfort Seats with perforated V-Tex leatherette surfaces
- MIB3 Composition Media with AM/FM/HD and SiriusXM 360L
- Four-Wheel Independent Suspension with speed-sensing steering
- Forward Collision Warning with Autonomous Emergency Braking
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- VW Care prepaid scheduled maintenance with 30,000-mile servicing
- 2-Row Rubber Monster Mats with Logo Kit and heavy-duty trunk liner
- Power driver seat with telescoping and tilt steering wheel
- Dual front and side impact airbags with overhead airbags
- 17 two-tone machined and black alloy wheels
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- Emergency communication system with VW Car-Net services

The 2.0L TSI DOHC engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive provides adequate performance for both highway commuting and everyday driving. Fuel economy registers at 21 city and 27 highway miles per gallon, offering reasonable efficiency for this class of vehicle.

Interior accommodations include heated front comfort seats, a front center armrest, and a split-folding rear seat that provides flexibility for cargo and passenger configurations. The power driver seat, power windows, and power door mirrors contribute to convenience, while the overhead console and trip computer help you monitor vehicle information.

The cabin features a six-speaker audio system with steering wheel-mounted controls for easy operation while driving. Climate control is managed through automatic temperature regulation with independent front dual-zone capability and rear window defrosting.

Safety systems integrated throughout include forward collision warning with autonomous emergency braking, electronic stability control, traction control, brake assist, and a comprehensive airbag system. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide stopping confidence.

This Tiguan SE demonstrates the practical approach Volkswagen has built into the model. With VW Care prepaid maintenance included and the extended range remote engine start feature for convenience, ownership is straightforward. We invite you to visit and see this vehicle firsthand.

2018 CHEVROLET SUBURBAN 1500 LS 4WD 8 PASSENGER SUV POWERED BY THE 5.3L V8 ENGINE WITH 79,127 MILES. ALL NEW GOODYEAR TIRES! This SUV is ''SILVER CERTIFIED''. Read on to understand what a ''Silver Certified'' SUV is.

For transparent, convenient shopping we classify each of our pre-owned vehicles into 1 of 4 tiers: Gold Certified, Silver Certified, Bronze Certified, and Backlot Certified. The overall goal of this program is to provide a simple, efficient purchase experience.

To be Gold Certified, a vehicle must exceed PA's minimum safety standards by a significant margin. In addition, it must have matching name-brand tires with at least 50% tread remaining, as well as clean brake rotor surfaces with at least 50% pad life remaining. All systems must pass a full functionality test and no drivability issues may be present. All factory recommended services must be performed by one of our technicians. Further, the Carfax History Report may have no negative comments. And notably, its cosmetic condition must be virtually perfect inside and out. If the vehicle passes all of this criteria, it is ''Gold Certified''.

A Silver Certified vehicle is very similar. However it may have some minor blemishes that can be seen when performing a close-up inspection. In addition, a few minor Carfax issues may be present. Nontheless, one's first impression of these vehicles will be very positive.

A Bronze Certified vehicle will have some cosmetic flaws or damage that are noticeable-even when doing a quick walk-around inspection. However it will have met a mechanical criteria nearly identical to our higher tiers.

And now for ''Backlot''. The overall condition of a Backlot vehicle is the lowest we offer. Tires may be off-brand. Some holes may be noticeable in the carpet or seats. Damaged or repainted exterior panels may be quite noticeable, even from a distance. In spite of these lower standards, we still stand behind the ''Backlot'' tier with a basic version of our warranty. The beauty is in the savings!

Here's a bit of information about our company. We specialize in providing thoroughly inspected, serviced, detailed, pre-owned passenger vans and business vehicles. Our in-house, nation-wide ''Golden Rule Warranty'' backs issues not covered by remaining factory warranty as well as unexpected big dollar repairs on vehicles with expired factory warranty. It's included in all transactions gratis! We also offer nationwide transportation, airport pickup, and competive financing.

Above all, we strive to live out the GOLDEN RULE as taught by Jesus Christ- treating others as we wish to be treated. Delayed disclosure of major fees, hidden charges, poor customer service, polished incompentence, and such like violate His Sacred Rule.

All customers, whether Mr. Nice or Mr. Arm Twister, benefit from our market-based ''no haggle'' pricing model. Transactions that do not include a trade-in receive a small courtesy discount, and a package purchase of 2 or more vehicles receives more. Consideration is also given to a repeat of a recent purchase. To keep our document fees reasonable, we vary them according to the complexity of the transaction. Upon request, we'll provide an out-the-door proposal within a few minutes.

In summary, we strive to provide a simple, GOLDEN RULE experience for each customer-the Jones Family and the Jones Fleet. Nearby and far. For the first time and the 10th time. - Daryl and Miriam Martin (Owners)

Built for the job, this truck comes equipped with a heavy-duty rear locking differential that improves traction when you need it most, whether you're on a construction site or handling challenging terrain. The trailering package includes an auxiliary external transmission oil cooler, ensuring reliable performance when you're towing. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide stopping confidence in varied conditions, while electronic stability control and traction control work together to maintain control during acceleration and braking.

* Heated seats
* Backup camera

* Plug-in electric drive w/ gasoline range extender

The Gianelle VS Forged wheels are a major upgrade from the factory wheels. They were approximately $5,000 new, and the four Michelin tires are brand new, representing approximately another $1,800 in replacement cost.

I have included 27 detailed photos so you can see the condition for yourself. I am happy to provide additional photos, videos or a video walk-around to serious buyers.

This is a unique opportunity for someone who appreciates the ELR for what it is: a rare, beautifully designed Cadillac luxury coupe with an unusually advanced powertrain for its era.

description:
Introducing the 2027 Ford Expedition Max Platinum a full-size SUV engineered to deliver capability, comfort, and commanding presence for families who demand more from their vehicle.

- 3.5L V6 EcoBoost High Output engine with 10-speed automatic transmission
- 4-wheel drive with 3.73 axle ratio
- Heated and ventilated leather-trimmed front captain's chairs with memory settings
- Power panoramic vista roof with power shade
- Bang & Olufsen sound system with 10 speakers and SiriusXM 360L satellite radio
- Google Maps navigation system integrated with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Ford Co-Pilot360 Active 2.0 advanced driver assistance technology
- Heated and ventilated front seats plus heated rear seats
- Power-adjustable pedals with memory and power tilt/telescopic steering column
- Auto high-beam headlights with delay-off feature and fully automatic control
- Electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist
- Four-wheel independent suspension for smooth highway and off-road capability
- 20-inch ebony bright machined aluminum wheels
- Power-folding sideview mirrors with autofold and heated operation

The Expedition Max Platinum presents itself with purposeful styling. The gray exterior features a carbon black front bumper, ebony painted grille with magnetite accent bars, and an illuminated rear spoiler. Black platinum badging on the tailgate, ebony trim appliques, and active air damming complete the sophisticated appearance. Turn signal indicator mirrors and power door mirrors enhance visibility and functionality.

Inside, the cabin prioritizes luxury and connectivity. Leather steering wheel with mounted audio controls, overhead console with garage door transmitter, and genuine wood dashboard and door panel inserts create an upscale environment. The wireless charging pad, digital device holder, and Ford Digital Experience interface keep passengers connected. Memory settings for the driver's seat, steering wheel, and power-adjustable pedals ensure personalized comfort for frequent drivers.

Safety and security receive comprehensive attention. Dual front and side impact airbags, occupant sensing technology, overhead airbags, and a rear-facing exterior camera provide protection and awareness. The emergency communication system includes 911 Assist, while the security system and panic alarm add peace of mind. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and integrated trailer brake control deliver confident stopping power.

Versatility defines the Expedition Max platform. Three rows of seating accommodate passengers with split-bench third-row seating and a reclining third-row option. Front bucket seats and split folding rear seat provide flexible configurations. Heated rear seats extend comfort to all occupants, while the heavy-duty trailer tow package with integrated trailer brake control supports substantial towing demands.

With 15 city MPG and 22 highway MPG, this full-size SUV balances capability with reasonable efficiency. The engine employs active noise cancellation for refined operation, while rain-sensing wipers and speed-sensitive wiper adjustment respond to conditions automatically. Automatic temperature control with dual front zone capability and rear air conditioning ensures climate comfort throughout the cabin.

For nearly 70 years, our family has proudly served families across Kentucky and beyond. We believe buying a vehicle should feel simple, honest, and stress-free. Our finance team works closely with trusted lenders to help you find a payment that fits your budget.

This 2026 BMW X3 M50 xDrive represents a refined balance of performance, comfort, and advanced technology designed for discerning drivers who demand more from their luxury SUV.

- Front Ventilated Seats
- Front & Rear Heated Seats
- Rear Climate Control Console
- Driving Assistance Professional Package with Traffic Jam Assistant
- M Sport Professional Package with Full LED Headlights and Cornering Light
- Premium Package including BMW Curved Display with HUD
- Parking View with 3D View Surround View System
- Harman/Kardon Surround Sound System
- Distance Control (ACC) with Steering Assistant
- Lane Change Assistant
- M Sport Brakes with Blue Calipers
- 20 M Jet Black Alloy Wheels
- Navigation System with BMW Maps
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Compatibility
- Heated Steering Wheel

The M50 xDrive combines the efficiency of its inline-six engine with intelligent all-wheel-drive technology, delivering 25 mpg in the city and 30 mpg on the highway. The gray exterior finish presents a sophisticated appearance that complements the vehicle's athletic stance and purposeful design.

Inside, the cabin exemplifies BMW's commitment to driver-focused luxury. Front ventilated and heated seats work in concert with rear heated seats and climate control to ensure personalized comfort for all occupants. Premium touches like the heated steering wheel and leather-wrapped sport steering wheel enhance every drive, while the Harman/Kardon surround sound system transforms your commute into an immersive audio experience.

The Driving Assistance Professional Package elevates your confidence on the road with lane change assistance and traffic jam support, enabling hands-off driving on motorways up to 40 mph and hands-on assisted driving up to 130 mph. The M Sport Professional Package contributes full LED headlights with cornering lights and extended shadowline trim, establishing a commanding visual presence.

Technology integration is seamless with the BMW Curved Display and head-up display, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, wireless device charging, and personal eSIM 5G connectivity. The Parking View with 3D surround view system makes maneuvering intuitive and stress-free.

With only 8,663 miles, this vehicle remains essentially new, offering you the confidence of a factory-fresh vehicle with the flexibility to personalize it to your exact preferences. We invite you to experience this exceptional SUV firsthand and discover why the X3 M50 xDrive continues to set the standard for luxury performance in its class.

The Pacifica Limited is equipped with all-weather capability through its all-wheel drive system and advanced suspension tuning. Rain-sensing wipers automatically adjust to conditions, while the rear window defroster ensures clear visibility in challenging weather.

No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.Safety and Security Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. This 2023 Honda Accord EX delivers a blend of reliability, efficiency, and modern convenience that makes it an excellent choice for daily driving and beyond.

- 1.5T turbocharged engine with 29 city / 37 highway MPG
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow
- Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS)
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Power moonroof
- Heated front bucket seats
- Front dual zone automatic temperature control
- 180-watt AM/FM audio system with 8 speakers
- Exterior parking camera with rear view
- Auto High-beam Headlights
- 17-inch alloy wheels
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering

The Accord's turbocharged 1.5L engine provides responsive power while maintaining impressive fuel efficiency. With 29 miles per gallon in the city and 37 on the highway, you'll spend less time at the pump and more time on the road. The continuously variable transmission ensures smooth acceleration and optimal performance across all driving conditions.

Inside, the cabin reflects thoughtful design and premium touches. Heated front bucket seats keep you comfortable during cooler months, while the front dual zone automatic climate control lets both driver and passenger set their preferred temperatures independently. The power moonroof adds an open-air experience when weather permits, and the split-folding rear seat provides flexibility for cargo or passengers.

Technology is seamlessly integrated throughout this Accord. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility keeps your smartphone connected to the 180-watt audio system, making navigation and entertainment intuitive. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls put essential functions right at your fingertips. The auto-dimming rear-view mirror and fully automatic headlights with delay-off function help you stay focused on the drive.

Safety features work quietly in the background to protect you and your passengers. Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow technology reduces driver fatigue during highway commutes and stop-and-go traffic alike. The Lane Keeping Assist System actively helps keep you centered in your lane, while a comprehensive airbag system including dual front, front side, knee, and overhead airbags provides layered protection. Electronic Stability Control, ABS brakes, and four-wheel independent suspension all contribute to confident handling and stopping power.

This gray 2023 Accord EX with just 9,572 miles represents an opportunity to own a vehicle that balances practicality with modern comfort. We invite you to experience this sedan in person and discover how well it suits your driving needs.

description:
This 2017 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LTZ offers the combination of capability and comfort that today's truck buyer demands, backed by proven performance and intelligent design.

- Full-feature leather-appointed heated and vented front bucket seats with 10-way power adjusters
- Chevrolet MyLink radio with navigation and 8-inch color touchscreen, featuring Bluetooth streaming and voice control
- Bose premium audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio
- Power sunroof
- 20-inch chrome wheels
- Integrated trailer brake controller
- Enhanced Driver Alert Package with Lane Keep Assist, IntelliBeam headlamps, Low Speed Forward Automatic Braking, and Front and Rear Park Assist
- LTZ Plus Package with power adjustable pedals and heated leather steering wheel
- LED cargo box lighting
- Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear window defroster
- Remote vehicle starter system
- OnStar with 4G LTE
- Heavy-duty rear locking differential
- Rear vision camera with exterior parking camera
- Wireless charging

The EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission delivers the power you expect from a full-size truck, managing 15 mpg in the city and 20 mpg on the highway. Four-wheel drive capability provides confidence on varied terrain, while the integrated trailer brake controller and heavy-duty locking differential demonstrate this truck's commitment to serious work.

Inside, the LTZ cabin speaks to refinement without sacrificing practicality. The heated and vented leather seats make long drives comfortable, while the 10-way power adjusters and memory settings let you find your perfect position instantly. The Bose audio system ensures quality sound whether you're streaming through Bluetooth or enjoying satellite radio.

Safety and convenience technology are woven throughout this truck. The Enhanced Driver Alert Package brings together Lane Keep Assist, IntelliBeam automatic high beams, forward collision alert, and park assist features. The rear vision camera and exterior parking camera give you clear visibility, while OnStar connectivity keeps you connected and secure.

The truck bed features LED lighting and a spray-on liner, making cargo management straightforward. Chrome accents throughout from the bumpers to the bodyside moldings and 20-inch wheels give this Silverado presence both on and off the job site.

This Silverado 1500 LTZ represents a mature, well-equipped truck ready for whatever comes next. We encourage you to schedule a test drive to experience its capabilities firsthand.

Experience the thrill of driving a legendary muscle car with this 2014 Ford Shelby GT500 Coupe. Boasting just 3,367 miles, this high-performance vehicle is finished in striking Deep Impact Blue Metallic, complemented by a Charcoal Black interior with sleek black accents. Powered by a supercharged 5.8-liter V8 producing an impressive 662 horsepower at 6,500 rpm and 631 lb-ft of torque at 4,000 rpm, this GT500 delivers exhilarating speed and acceleration. Equipped with a Tremec 6-speed manual transmission and rear-wheel drive, it offers an engaging driving experience. This used Shelby features modern comforts like Bluetooth connectivity, fog lights, heated leather seats, satellite radio readiness, and Xenon headlights, making it both a thrill on the road and a comfortable ride for up to four occupants.

This iconic muscle car combines performance with safety and security features that give peace of mind without compromising on power. It is equipped with Brembo premium brakes for superior stopping power, alongside 4-wheel Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) and power door locks to enhance security. An anti-theft system with a glass breakage sensor and a programmable safety key further protect the vehicle from theft, while the advanced safety features ensure confident driving in various conditions. The Shelby GT500 s robust safety package makes it a reliable choice for enthusiasts who demand both speed and security.

==== 2014 Ford Shelby GT500 Safety and Security Features ====

This vehicle features Brembo premium brakes for optimal stopping, an anti-theft system with a glass breakage sensor, 4-wheel ABS, power door locks, and a programmable safety key, providing comprehensive security and safety on every drive.

==== 2014 Ford Shelby GT500 Entertainment and Technology Features ====

Enjoy modern connectivity with hands-free phone call integration that is voice operated, along with a premium sound system featuring two subwoofers and a total of eight speakers. The vehicle offers electronic messaging assistance with a read function and USB auxiliary audio input, ensuring entertainment and convenience are always within reach.

==== 2014 Ford Shelby GT500 Performance Features ====

The Shelby GT500 comes with a rear limited slip differential, enhancing traction and stability during aggressive driving, making it a true powerhouse on the road.
